full_prompt_en: A square expressionist painting presses a man's face and raised hand close to the picture plane amid fractured electric color. The head fills nearly the full height, with dark hair and a saturated yellow forehead touching the upper edge. One eye at the left opens widely under a heavy black brow, while the other peers past a hand held upright against the side of the face. The hand climbs from the lower right to the upper right, its yellow-orange fingers creating a bright vertical bar beside the eyes. The nose and cheeks are built from abrupt planes of yellow, scarlet, hot pink, teal, and violet rather than blended natural skin tones. A deep black patch around the lower face and an open dark mouth make the expression appear startled or strained. At the bottom left, a black jacket and a sliver of pale collar emerge from the colorful head before sinking into shadow. The background is not a literal room; broad purple, blue, and green areas crowd the face and break into scraped marks. Thick paint and rough scumbles remain visible across the cheek, brow, and hand, while some thin linear scratches cut through the layers. The close crop gives the viewer little distance from the figure, and the wide eye becomes a sharp focal point amid unstable patches of color. Light is expressed through brilliant yellow and orange pigment on the forehead, nose, and hand, opposed by teal and near-black shadow; it does not imply one realistic lamp. No readable letters are visible. The overall composition feels compressed and agitated, with the raised hand, startled eye, and clashing warm-cool strokes forming a restless diagonal and vertical rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义绘画把男子面孔与抬起的手推到画面近前，四周充满碎裂的电光色彩。头部几乎占满全高，深色头发和饱和黄色额头触及上边缘。左边一只眼在厚重黑眉下睁得很大，另一只眼从竖在脸侧的手旁望出。手从右下向右上攀升，黄橙色手指在双眼旁形成明亮的竖条。鼻子和脸颊由黄、猩红、炽热粉红、青绿与紫的突兀平面搭成，而非调和的自然肤色。下半脸周围一块深黑色与张开的暗色嘴巴使神情看起来惊愕或紧绷。左下角的黑外套和一小片浅色领口从多彩头部下方显出，随后没入阴影。背景不是具体室内；大片紫、蓝、绿挤向脸庞，并碎成刮擦笔迹。厚重颜料与粗糙的干擦留在脸颊、眉和手上，一些细线状划痕穿过色层。紧密裁切让观看者与人物几乎没有距离，睁大的眼睛成为不稳定色块中的锐利焦点。光线通过额头、鼻子和手上的亮黄与橙色颜料表现，与青绿及近黑阴影对照，并不暗示某一盏真实灯。没有可读字母。整体构图压迫而躁动，抬起的手、惊愕的眼和冲撞的冷暖笔触形成不安的斜线与竖向节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image has a vigorous expressionist painting surface, with thick dragged strokes, scumbled patches, and scratched linear accents left openly visible. Broken planes meet at rough edges, and dark marks anchor key contours without making them smooth. Acid yellow, hot orange, crimson, violet, and teal collide with near-black, so warmth advances abruptly against cold shadow. Illumination is carried by pigment contrast rather than a consistent physical source: brilliant patches flash forward while heavy dark areas absorb detail. The crop is close and asymmetric, allowing large unstable shapes to push against the frame and concentrate tension near one bright focal area. Surface texture is coarse and changeable, alternating opaque impasto with thin scraped passages. The overall effect is urgent, compressed, and emotionally unsettled, with color and mark-making doing as much work as recognizable form.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有有力的表现主义绘画表面，厚重拖笔、粗糙干擦色块和划出的细线强调都公开可见。碎裂平面在粗糙边缘相遇，深色笔迹稳住关键轮廓，却不把它抚平。酸黄、炽橙、猩红、紫和青绿与近黑相撞，暖色突然前冲，对抗冷色阴影。照明由颜料反差而非一致的真实光源承担：明亮色块向前闪出，厚重暗区吞没细节。裁切贴近且不对称，大块不稳定形状挤压画框，将张力集中于一处明亮焦点。表面肌理粗粝多变，在不透明厚涂与薄薄刮擦之间交替。整体效果紧迫、压缩而情绪不安，色彩与笔迹和可辨形体一样承担表达。
theme_en: An anxious close-up painted face with a raised hand in fractured electric color
theme_zh: 以碎裂电光色彩绘制的焦虑面容特写与抬起的手
name: Expressionism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
